about_the_game:
You suddenly acquire the ability to use troll spells in chess — for no reason at all.

Determined to try out your new powers at the local chess club, you’ll face four opponents ranging from Mirai, a beginner, to the mysterious club owner who surpasses human skill.

This game is a hybrid strategy experience that layers mana and spell cards on top of traditional, turn-based chess rules. While your opponent plays normal chess, you charge mana each turn to transform pieces, move your opponent’s pieces to other squares, or cast temporary buffs and other disruptive spells.

The rules of the chessboard are no longer safe.
You’ve stepped beyond cold logic and predictable moves into a battlefield of unexpected tactics and magic.
Transform pieces, shift positions, overturn your opponent’s plans — and witness scenarios impossible in traditional chess unfold before your eyes.
Break the mold of the classics and forge new victories in the chaos.

Right now, a strange chess world — where magic and trolling intertwine — awaits you.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or AMD Radeon HD 6450
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: One day, you gain the power to cast a troll spell in a chess game. Eager to try it out, you head to the chess club—where rivals range from novice Mirai to the mysterious owner who surpasses human skill. The rules of chess are no longer safe. Will you seize victory, or be swallowed by chaos?
